$comment: Every word the workshop screen shows about itself, in one place.  Moving these out of index.html is not tidiness: this project's most expensive repeated failure is a sentence that was true on the day it was written, and a sentence spread across an HTML file and a Python module cannot be found by grepping for its translation.  Chinese is the source language -- the screen is written in Chinese -- and `en` is filled only where a translation exists, because a half-translated screen is worse than a Chinese one.  Placeholders are `{name}` and are substituted verbatim; a key with no `{` is used as-is.
